data.title: Black Friday: Save 33% on Pioneer Packs!
data.summary: Save big on the website and with the Steam Autumn Sale!
data.content:
Harvest stellar bargains with 33% off Pioneer Packs as part of Black Friday and the Steam Autumn Sale.

33% off Pioneer Packs

If you decide to venture into the Wild Ten permanently, you can save 33% on Pioneer Packs until December 4 via warrobotsfrontiers.com and Steam. They grant full Early Access to War Robots: Frontiers, plus a host of battle-ready in-game content.

  • Iron Pack: Contains Early Access and 4 Orkans (Weapons).
  • Steel Pack: Contains Early Access, 4 Orkans (Weapons), Varangian (Robot), 300 WarpReals (in-game currency).
  • Titanium Pack: Early Access, 4 Orkans (Weapons), Varangian (Robot), 750 WarpReals (in-game currency), Kate (Pilot), 1 “Sinclair” Decal, 1 Premium Battle Pass, 90-day Premium Account.
  • Platinum Pack: Early Access, 4 Orkans (Weapons), Varangian (Robot), 1250 WarpReals (in-game currency), Kate (Pilot), 1 “Sinclair” Decal, 4 Premium Battle Passes, 1-year Premium Account.

All packs will be discounted on the website and in the Steam Autumn Sale until December 4. Happy shopping, Pilots!
